extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: retro food truck (street food van), approx. 6.3 x 2.3 x 3.2 m (L x W x H incl. chimney), wheel diameter 0.80 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the serving hatch 'food-truck_hatch' on the right side is a separate object with its origin on the top hinge, modelled propped open (about 72 degrees, rotate around its local hinge axis to close; the two props are part of the hatch); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); translucent windows with seats, steering wheel and a small kitchen inside; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
